meta.purpose: Pre-registered training/evaluation protocol - design only, no training executed

decoder_feature_source.rule: final transformer layer only (layer index 23, post-model-closing-LayerNorm)
decoder_feature_source.rationale: Deliberately decouples 'which layers produce segmentation features' (fixed, identical across all conditions) from 'which layers receive LoRA' (the experimental variable). Using multiple/variable backbone layers as decoder input would confound the two.

decoder.initialization: PyTorch default (Kaiming-uniform for Conv2d, ones/zeros for GroupNorm) - standard framework default, not a special scheme

lora.actual_module_structure_finding: timm.models.vision_transformer.Attention (used by Prithvi's Block) implements a SINGLE FUSED 'qkv: Linear(1024, 3072, bias=qkv_bias)' layer, not separate W_q/W_k/W_v matrices. Verified by direct source inspection this phase.
lora.resolution: LoRA (rank 8) applied to the Q-slice (output rows 0:1024) and V-slice (output rows 2048:3072) of the fused qkv weight's output space; the K-slice (rows 1024:2048) receives zero LoRA contribution. Mathematically equivalent to separate-matrix W_q/W_v-only LoRA. This is a standard, well-precedented technique for fused-qkv architectures, not an invented one.
lora.resolution_status: NEW Phase 2B-B implementation decision - the original freeze's 'W_q/W_v' language predates this architectural inspection
lora.alpha_rationale: alpha = 2 x rank is a widely-used LoRA convention (effective scale = alpha/rank = 2.0); chosen as the standard default rather than tuned
lora.dropout_rationale: No LoRA dropout - dataset is already small (20 target-train images); additional stochastic regularization was not judged necessary and is not tuned post-hoc
lora.A_initialization: Kaiming-uniform (standard LoRA convention, same as the original LoRA paper)
lora.B_initialization: zeros (standard LoRA convention - guarantees the adapted model is initially identical to the frozen backbone before any training)
lora.original_qkv_weight: frozen, untouched (LoRA adds a parallel low-rank delta, does not modify the original weight in place)

random_K.rationale: 3 seeds is the minimal number that permits a non-degenerate mean+/-std report (n=2 gives an unstable std estimate); kept minimal given Kaggle/Colab-scale compute stated in the original project abstract. This is a limitation, not a claim of full statistical robustness.
random_K.selection_method: random.Random(seed).sample(range(24), K) - same deterministic mechanism already used in Phase 2A

identified_collisions.treatment: train once, report under both labels
train once, report under both labels
train once, report under both labels

source_potsdam.labels_used: as already established in frozen methodology

target_probe.role: unsupervised DSS layer selection (already executed, frozen)
target_probe.note: same 5 files participate in supervised training using their labels, in the same role as the other 15 target-train files - this is not leakage because label information never influenced the already-fixed layer-selection decision

target_test.role: final evaluation only, single pass, after full experimental configuration is locked

loss.formula: L = L_CE + L_Dice, L_Dice computed per-class (macro-averaged) on softmax probabilities
loss.rationale: Verified real class imbalance (car 1.011%, clutter_background 0.852% vs ~23-26% for the four dominant classes) rules out assuming balance. Dice loss is inherently robust to class imbalance (set-overlap based, not pixel-frequency based); combined with CE for stable pixel-wise gradients. This avoids introducing an additional, separately-tuned class-weight hyperparameter as a hidden free parameter.
loss.ignore_index_rationale: Not needed - all pixels in target-train ground truth map cleanly to one of the 6 known classes (0 unmapped pixels found)

training_hyperparameters.lr_rationale: Single shared LR for decoder + LoRA parameters (one param group) - avoids a second LR-ratio hyperparameter that would itself be a garden-of-forking-paths risk; standard AdamW default-scale LR for a from-scratch small decoder + LoRA adapters
training_hyperparameters.precision_rationale: MPS (Apple Silicon) mixed-precision/autocast support is less mature and less deterministic than CUDA's; fp32 chosen for reliability and reproducibility on this specific hardware, not as a general prohibition on mixed precision
training_hyperparameters.best_checkpoint_rule: highest mean IoU on target-validation, evaluated every checkpoint_frequency_steps
training_hyperparameters.early_stopping: none - fixed 2000-step budget, best checkpoint by validation mIoU is kept regardless of whether it occurs before step 2000
training_hyperparameters.device: mps (Apple M5) with cpu fallback if unavailable at execution time

crop_and_tiling.training_crop_sampling: random crop per training step from a randomly-selected target-train image, uniform over image and over file
crop_and_tiling.validation_test_tiling: sliding window, stride 112 (50% overlap), reflect-padded to a multiple of 224 at image borders
crop_and_tiling.overlap_aggregation: average overlapping logits (not majority vote), then argmax over the 6 classes
crop_and_tiling.augmentation_rationale: Geometric-only augmentation (no color/intensity jitter) - color-space augmentation was judged inappropriate given Strategy C's frozen, source-fit-only radiometric calibration; adding independent color jitter on top of an already-fixed calibration is not authorized by any frozen decision and was not introduced here
crop_and_tiling.normalization: identical to the frozen DSS input pipeline (Strategy C affine, then per-band mean/std, zero-fill for Blue/SWIR1/SWIR2) - unchanged

seeds.dataloader_worker_seed: not applicable - single-process data loading planned given small dataset size
seeds.per_condition_policy: one fixed seed (1000) per non-Random-K condition; Random-K conditions use the 3 pre-registered seeds (101,202,303) for layer selection, combined with the same training seed (1000) for the training process itself
seeds.mps_determinism_caveat: Bit-exact determinism on MPS across training runs (with active gradient computation, dropout if any, and data shuffling) has NOT been empirically verified in this project - only the frozen, no_grad(), no-dropout DSS forward pass was verified bit-exact (Phase 2B-A). This is recorded as a limitation, not assumed.

evaluation.confusion_matrix_accumulation: accumulated per-image over the full tiled/stitched prediction before computing metrics, then summed across all images in the split
evaluation.validation_use: every checkpoint_frequency_steps, for best-checkpoint selection only
evaluation.test_use: exactly once per condition, only after that condition's training is fully complete and the best validation checkpoint is fixed
evaluation.test_evaluation_timing: not before Phase 2C training is authorized and executed

efficiency_measurement_plan.flops_claim_policy: Trainable parameter count reductions will NOT be presented as implying proportional FLOPs or wall-clock training-time reductions unless both are actually measured - the frozen backbone runs its full forward pass regardless of how many layers carry LoRA
efficiency_measurement_plan.hardware_to_report: Apple M5, 10-core GPU, 16GB unified memory, MPS backend, PyTorch 2.14.0, Python 3.12.13
